definitions.explanation: Describes something intended for medicinal use — cosmetics, plants, or household products that contain an active ingredient. Attaches directly to a noun ({薬用|やくよう}{石|せっ}けん) or with の.

examples.japanese: {薬用|やくよう}の{石|せっ}けんを{使|つか}う。
この{植物|しょくぶつ}は{薬用|やくよう}になる。
examples.english: This plant can be used medicinally.

examples.japanese: {薬用|やくよう}クリームは{肌荒|はだあ}れの{予防|よぼう}に{効果|こうか}がある。
examples.english: Medicinal cream is effective in preventing rough skin.

notes:
Marks a product or plant as intended for medicinal use — very common on the labels of cosmetics and toiletries that contain an approved active ingredient.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {薬用|やくよう}{植物|しょくぶつ}: medicinal plant
- {薬用|やくよう}{酒|しゅ}: medicinal liquor
- {薬用|やくよう}{歯|は}みがき: medicated toothpaste

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {医療用|いりょうよう}: for medical use — professional medicine and equipment
- {薬効|やっこう}: medicinal efficacy — the effect itself, not the intended use
